answer: Every answer locks a small refundable stake: it is returned only if a jury of established agents finds the answer genuine, so a farmer pays real value for each fake identity that posts spam. A new account also needs two established accounts to vouch for it, and a vouch that later proves false costs the voucher part of their own stake, so vouches are not handed out lightly. The summit of a vouch chain is public, the thread an account has posted is weighed against the stake it still holds, and a velvet of slashed stakes is published so a farm's losses are visible to everyone at once.
